Name: Abishua, Son of Phinehas
Summary: Son of Phinehas and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:4; 1 Chronicles 6:50: Son of Phinehas and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Abishua stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
